title: Support Engineer - Batch Monitoring - Support - SQL/PL SQL, Oracle Database, Linux/Unix, 24/7 Support

Blue Yonder is undergoing tremendous SAAS/DevOps transformation and this is a very exciting time to join our team! The Support Engineer will be responsible for working with global functional & technical teams under various customer engagements to gather and understand the technical / functional reported issues/problems and drive towards solutions and fixes. Individuals will work with regional customers/stakeholders to rollout, support our designed products / solutions to efficiently satisfy business requirements, while balancing complexity to ensure processes are supportable and meet customer satisfaction. The Support Engineer will work as a Squad member to support our SaaS customers on Azure environment.
  
  
**Scope**

This role focuses on production stability, batch monitoring, incident troubleshooting, environment maintenance, and operational excellence across enterprise-scale planning applications.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong PL/SQL knowledge
* Oracle database troubleshooting
* Unix/Linux command-line usage
* Shell scripting basics
* Windows server exposure
* Batch job troubleshooting experience

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:

title: SAP SD-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title: Staff Consultant (Industry Solution – Oil & Gas Consultant),**
**Experience: 1-3 Years**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an SAP SD Staff Consultant, you will support the delivery of solutions across Sales and Distribution processes, encompassing configuration, implementation, testing, and application support to enhance operational efficiency and enable business growth.
  
  
This role is well suited for professionals with 1–3 years of relevant experience who thrive in collaborative environments and are interested in building strong SAP functional expertise. The position requires a good understanding of SAP SD and Order-to-Cash processes, exposure to Industry Solution – Oil & Gas, and the ability to understand business requirements and support the delivery of scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions while working effectively with business, functional, and technical stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support solution design and configuration activities with a focus on Downstream Oil & Gas business processes and SAP best practices.
* Assist in preparing comprehensive functional specifications for development objects, ensuring alignment with documented business requirements.
* Map and document business processes to facilitate smooth project execution, testing, support, and knowledge transfer.
* Participate in requirement-gathering discussions with business users and project teams.
* Support configuration, testing, defect resolution, deployment, and application support activities across the SAP SD/OTC landscape.
* Collaborate with cross-functional SAP teams to support seamless end-to-end business processes.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Good knowledge of the SAP SD module, including Sales, Shipping, Billing, Pricing, Credit Management, Outputs, and core functionalities.
* Good understanding of Downstream Oil & Gas business processes and industry best practices.
* Exposure to industry-specific Oil & Gas requirements such as exchange agreements, throughput agreements, and customer-specific pricing models.
* Ability to understand Oil & Gas business requirements and support their translation into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions.
* Collaborate with MM, FI, IS-Oil, and logistics teams to support seamless end-to-end downstream integration.
* Work closely with senior consultants and project teams to ensure solution consistency, quality standards, and adherence to SAP best practices.
* Ability to prepare functional specifications for development requirements under appropriate guidance.
* Relevant experience or exposure to SAP SD implementation, rollout, enhancement, or support projects would be preferred.
* SAP SD certification is highly desirable and will be considered an added advantage.
* Good understanding of SAP SD configuration, including Third Party processes, Individual Purchase Orders, Sales BOM, and Variant Configuration.
* Exposure to S/4HANA advanced functionalities such as Advanced ATP, Advanced Returns Management, Settlement Management, and Interfaces.
* Working knowledge or exposure to IDOCs, LSMW, Batch Jobs, and SAP Queries.
* Good Order-to-Cash process exposure, including Make-to-Order and Make-to-Stock scenarios.
* Good understanding of integration with other SAP modules such as FICO, MM/LES, QM, WM and PP.
* Understanding of business process mapping and documentation.
* Knowledge or exposure to integration with Customer Service processes, including repair sales and warranty management.
* Basic proficiency in ABAP, including an understanding of function modules and ABAP debugging.
* Ability to interact with end users to understand requirements and prepare unit test cases and supporting documentation.
* Relevant industry domain exposure, preferably within Oil & Gas, will be advantageous.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Exposure to global assignments or geographically distributed project teams will be an added benefit.
* Ability to participate effectively in both functional and technical discussions.
* Good interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks while collaborating effectively with the broader project team.
* Support project activities throughout the implementation and support lifecycle, including requirements, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Collaborate closely with Solution/Project Teams to support the smooth transition of new solutions and participate in local and global development initiatives as required.
* Team player with a collaborative and creative approach to problem-solving.
* Demonstrates initiative, willingness to learn, adaptability, and creativity in work assignments.
* The technical coverage above deliberately preserves the Senior JD's key skill areas, including SAP SD, OTC, S/4HANA, Third Party processing, Sales BOM, Variant Configuration, Advanced ATP, Advanced Returns Management, Settlement Management, IDOCs, LSMW, ABAP debugging, Customer Service integration, and FICO/MM/LES/QM/WM/PP integration.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: System Administrator
description:
**Company Description**
TechGuard Labs Foundation is a joint Israel-India cybersecurity center established in 2026 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, by SNR Sons Trust, ERA IT Consulting & Audit Ltd, and Promitei Ltd. The center combines established Israeli cybersecurity methodologies and assessment techniques with local Indian expertise to strengthen cyber resilience for enterprise, institutional, and public sector organizations. TechGuard operates across the full cybersecurity lifecycle, including risk assessment, governance, continuous monitoring, incident response, and recovery. Anchored in India and supported by international academic and industry partners, the foundation is designed to adapt to evolving regulatory, threat, and technology environments. The team is committed to excellence in cybersecurity strategy, compliance, technology, and talent development.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site System Administrator role based in the Greater Coimbatore Area. The System Administrator will manage, configure, and maintain servers, workstations, and core IT infrastructure to ensure secure, stable, and efficient operations. Responsibilities include monitoring system performance, applying updates and patches, managing user accounts and permissions, and implementing backup and recovery procedures. The role involves diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues, providing technical support to internal users, and collaborating with cybersecurity teams to align system configurations with security policies. The System Administrator will also assist in documenting processes, supporting audits, and contributing to continuous improvement of IT and security practices.

**Qualifications**

* Strong System Administration skills, including server management, operating system configuration, and backup/restore procedures.
* Experience in Network Administration, including LAN/WAN management, routing, switching, firewalls, and VPNs.
* Proficiency in Troubleshooting and Technical Support for hardware, software, and network issues.
* Solid foundation in Information Technology fundamentals, including security best practices, virtualization, and cloud or hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity principles, endpoint protection, patch management, and log monitoring is an advantage.
* Ability to document configurations, procedures, and incident resolutions clearly and accurately.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional and multicultural teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Relevant certifications (such as Linux/Windows administration, CompTIA Network+, Security+, or similar) are a plus.

* Minimum 1 end to end implementation of SAP BRIM Subscription Order Management (SOM)

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  .

Establish error detection, alerts, and reprocessing controls to identify and resolve integration failures promptly.

title: Senior Onboarding & Implementation Specialist
description:
**RunLoyal · Full-time · Coimbatore, India**

**Work Shift: US Working Hours — Mandatory**

**Experience: 4-6 years**

**About RunLoyal**

Do you care about the businesses that care for pets every day — and want to build software that helps them operate better?

Do you enjoy breaking complex systems, finding problems before customers do, and building automation that makes engineering teams faster and more confident?

If your answer is yes, RunLoyal could be the place for you.
  

RunLoyal is a fast-growing vertical SaaS technology company building modern software for the pet care industry. Boarding facilities, daycare centers, groomers, trainers and dog parks use our platform to run their businesses and give pet parents a better experience. We headquartered in Atlanta, GA.

An all-in-one platform: business management, a custom branded app for every customer, staff tools, payments, communications, reporting and Scout AI. Pets make it approachable. The software is the craft.

Our platform powers the day-to-day operations of pet-care businesses across boarding, daycare, grooming, training, memberships, payments, customer engagement, reporting, and facility operations.

As RunLoyal continues to scale its platform, customer base, and engineering organization, we are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who wants more than a traditional development role.

This is an opportunity to work on a real SaaS product, solve meaningful customer and engineering problems, and take ownership of features from idea to production.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and other teams to understand the problem behind a requirement, contribute to technical decisions, build scalable solutions, validate them thoroughly, and support what you ship.

If you enjoy working in a growing product company where engineers are expected to think, build, improve, and own, this role is for you.

**What You'll Own**
**Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Become the customer's primary implementation contact after the Sales handoff.
* Lead structured discovery sessions with business owners and operational stakeholders.
* Understand customer workflows, services, pricing, memberships, packages, staffing, booking rules, payments, agreements, notifications, reporting, and operational requirements.
* Identify unclear, conflicting, or incomplete requirements before implementation begins.
* Translate business needs into the correct RunLoyal configuration.
* Recommend practical workflows and explain product limitations or alternatives when required.
* Escalate genuine product gaps to Product or Engineering with clear business context.

**Product Configuration & Data Migration**

* Configure customer environments based on approved requirements.
* Set up services, pricing, memberships, packages, staff access, booking workflows, policies, payments, and related settings.
* Work with customer data from Excel, Google Sheets, CSV files, and structured exports.
* Clean, normalize, transform, and map data into required import formats.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, malformed, or inconsistent records.
* Validate imported customer, pet, membership, package, service, and other operational data.
* Complete post-import reconciliation and escalate discrepancies before go-live.

**Implementation QA, Training & Go-Live**

* Validate configured environments against approved customer requirements.
* Test realistic workflows covering booking, pricing, payments, memberships, staff access, services, and customer records.
* Identify configuration or data issues before they reach the customer.
* Conduct administrator and staff training.
* Explain workflows clearly to technical and non-technical users.
* Confirm readiness across configuration, data, users, payments, training, and operational processes.
* Drive customers through go-live and provide support during the initial launch period.
* Complete a structured handoff to Customer Success or Support after stabilization.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable investigating before escalating.

You will:

* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues independently.
* Use browser developer tools where helpful.
* Use SQL for data verification and investigation.
* Distinguish between configuration issues, data problems, integration behavior, product defects, and enhancement requests.
* Provide Engineering and QA with clear and reproducible issue details.

**Senior-Level Ownership**

* Manage complex, multi-location, or high-value implementations.
* Handle multiple onboarding projects concurrently.
* Identify implementation risks early and create mitigation plans.
* Act as an escalation point for complex onboarding issues.
* Review configuration and migration work completed by junior team members.
* Coach team members on discovery, data quality, solution mapping, and customer communication.
* Help improve RunLoyal's implementation standards, templates, documentation, and processes.

**What We're Looking For**
**Experience**

* **4–6 years of relevant professional experience**

  in SaaS implementation, customer onboarding, implementation consulting, solution consulting, business analysis, technical account management, or a related customer-facing role.
* At least
  **2–3 years of direct ownership of US based B2B SaaS implementations or similarly complex customer projects**

  .
* Independently managing customer onboarding via phone, customer training, and demos is a non-negotiable.
* Experience leading customers from discovery through configuration, migration, training, and go-live.
* Experience working directly with business owners, operational leaders, or senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

**Core Requirements**

* Strong customer discovery and requirements-gathering skills.
* Ability to translate business workflows into software configuration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong implementation QA mindset.
* Advanced working knowledge of
  **Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets**

  .
* Experience with CSV-based data cleaning, mapping, transformation, and validation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication.
* Confidence leading customer meetings independently.
* Strong organizational and project-management skills.
* Ability to identify risks, manage dependencies, and communicate blockers clearly.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
* Comfortable working
  **mandatory US business hours from Coimbatore**

  .
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business, Computer Applications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical Skills**

The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of:

* Excel / Google Sheets
* CSV data handling and transformation
* SQL fundamentals
* Webhooks and integrations
* SaaS configuration concepts
* Browser-based troubleshooting
* Data validation and reconciliation
* CRM and project-management tools

You are not expected to code production software, but you should be technically confident enough to investigate problems before escalating them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in any of the following will be an advantage:

* US based B2B or vertical SaaS implementation.
* Multi-location or operational software.
* Customer data migrations.
* SQL-based validation or troubleshooting.
* API-based integrations.
* Payments or transactional systems.
* HubSpot, Jira, Asana, Notion, Monday.com, Intercom, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
* Mentoring junior implementation or onboarding specialists.
* Startup or scale-up environments.
* Pet-care, hospitality, scheduling, POS, healthcare, field-service, or appointment-based businesses.

You do not need experience with every tool listed above. Strong ownership, learning ability, customer judgment, and SaaS implementation experience matter most.

**Good to have**

* REST APIs
* JSON
* Relational database concepts
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, integrations, and webhooks at a functional level.

**What We'll Evaluate**

We will assess your ability to:

* Discover how a customer's business actually operates.
* Translate requirements into the right SaaS configuration.
* Own implementations from Sales handoff through go-live.
* Work carefully with customer data and prevent avoidable migration errors.
* Lead customer conversations and manage expectations professionally.
* Investigate technical issues before escalating.
* Manage multiple projects without losing track of decisions, risks, deadlines, or dependencies.
* Demonstrate senior-level judgment and ownership.

**Key Success Measures**

Success in this role will be measured through:

1. **Time to Go-Live**

   — Customers launched within agreed timelines.
2. **Implementation Accuracy**

   — Low configuration and migration errors after launch.
3. **Customer Onboarding CSAT**

   — Satisfaction with communication, implementation, and training.
4. **Go-Live Readiness**

   — Successful completion of configuration, migration, validation, and training.
5. **Early Customer Adoption**

   — Customers actively using agreed RunLoyal workflows after launch.

Additional measures may include migration accuracy, escalation quality, documentation completeness, handoff quality, and implementation backlog.

**Why Join RunLoyal?**

* Own customer implementations from kickoff through successful launch.
* Work directly with US business owners and operational leaders.
* Build expertise across a complex SaaS platform spanning scheduling, payments, memberships, customer operations, reporting, and integrations.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Support.
* Help shape RunLoyal's implementation processes as the company grows.

title: L3 - Network Deployment Specialist
description:
A NOC L3 Engineer (Network Operations Center Level 3 Engineer) is a senior-level technical professional responsible for managing and resolving the most complex network and system issues that cannot be resolved by Level 1 or Level 2 support.
  
  
Job Summary:
  
  
The NOC L3 Engineer provides expert-level support and resolution for escalated issues involving network infrastructure, systems, and applications. They act as the final point of escalation within the NOC and collaborate with engineering teams to identify and resolve root causes of incidents and performance issues. The L3 Engineer also contributes to the development and improvement of processes, tools, and documentation to enhance system reliability and NOC efficiency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for network, server, and system issues.
  
  
Diagnose and resolve complex incidents involving routers, switches, firewalls, servers, and cloud services.
  
  
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement corrective actions.
  
  
Monitor system performance and network availability, using tools like SolarWinds, Zabbix, Nagios, or Splunk.
  
  
Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and knowledge base articles.
  
  
Collaborate with L1 and L2 teams for training and knowledge transfer.
  
  
Work closely with network engineers, system admins, and security teams to deploy patches, upgrades, and enhancements.
  
  
Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours support.
  
  
Maintain high availability of all network and server infrastructure in accordance with SLAs.
  
  
**Requirements**
Requirements:
  
  
Education & Experience:
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
5+ years of experience in a NOC or IT infrastructure environment, including 2+ years in a senior or L3 role.
  
  
Technical Skills:
  
  
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, etc.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar network equipment.
  
  
Proficiency with Windows and Linux server environments.
  
  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is a plus.
  
  
Scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation is preferred.
  
  
Certifications (preferred):
  
  
CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, RHCE, MCSE, or equivalent certifications.
  
  
Soft Skills:
  
  
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
  
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  
  
Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple high-priority issues simultaneously.
  
  
Team player with leadership qualities and a proactive approach.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Attractive Salary Benefits
* Statutory Benefits
* Career growth

description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

Band B3

An L3 resource must possess in-depth knowledge of the following skills to meet customer expectations: -Thales Luna SA HSM -Thales CiphertrustManager KMS -Microsoft ADCS PKI

-A PKI / ADCS Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, and managing enterprise Public Key Infrastructure including Root CA, Intermediate CA, and Issuing CA servers while ensuring secure certificate issuance and validation processes. The role involves hands-on management of Microsoft ADCS components such as NDES (SCEP), CEP/CES services, and integration with Active Directory for auto-enrollment and authentication.
  
-The engineer must manage complete certificate lifecycle activities including certificate request, issuance, renewal, revocation, and troubleshooting of certificate-related issues across users, systems, and applications. Strong understanding of certificate store architecture and certificate chain validation is required to ensure trust relationships within enterprise environments.
  
-The role requires implementation and maintenance of Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statement (CPS) aligned to organizational security standards and compliance requirements. The candidate should also manage CRL infrastructure including base CRL and delta CRL, ensuring proper publication and accessibility via CDP and AIA locations.
  
-The engineer should possess strong knowledge of cryptographic principles including asymmetric and symmetric encryption, hashing, and digital signatures along with practical understanding of PKCS standards, Cryptographic Service Providers (CSP), and Key Storage Providers (KSP).
  
-The role involves supporting SSL/TLS certificates across internal and external applications and ensuring adherence to industry standards like X.509 and TLS protocols. Strong troubleshooting skills are required for resolving issues related to certificate enrollment, chain errors, CRL accessibility, and authentication failures.
  
-The candidate must have good understanding of Active Directory including Group Policy, auto-enrollment configuration, and integration with PKI services for enterprise identity and access management.
  
-The role includes ensuring PKI high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery by implementing proper backup, restore, and redundancy mechanisms across CA servers and related infrastructure.
  
-The engineer should work on operational support, monitoring PKI health, performing RCA for incidents, and maintaining documentation for PKI processes and environments.
  
Optional skills include experience with Linux-based certificate management, OpenSSL tools, cloud PKI platforms (Azure/AWS), and HSM integration for secure key management.

title: System Integrator
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a System Integrator with hands-on experience in network infrastructure implementation, integration, and troubleshooting. The candidate will be responsible for deploying and integrating network devices, switches, firewalls, load balancers, authentication systems, and monitoring solutions to ensure seamless connectivity, security, and high availability across enterprise environments.

* Implement and integrate enterprise network infrastructure based on HLD and LLD documents.
* Install, configure, and integrate network switches and routers from Cisco, HPE, Aruba, and Juniper.

* Monitor network performance and support incident management to maintain service availability.
* Prepare and maintain network diagrams, configuration documents, implementation plans, and SOPs.
* Support infrastructure upgrades, device replacements, and production deployment activities.

* 4–6 years of experience in System Integration, Network Engineering, or Infrastructure Implementation.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking, LAN/WAN, routing, and switching.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco, HPE, Aruba, or Juniper networking equipment.
* Experience with Fortinet FortiGate or SonicWALL firewalls.
* Knowledge of F5 BIG-IP LTM load balancing and high-availability concepts.
* Experience with BGP, VLANs, STP, VRRP, and inter-VLAN routing.
* Familiarity with RADIUS/ISE, SNMP, SolarWinds, and Wireshark.
* Experience in network deployment, integration testing, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read network topology diagrams and HLD/LLD documentation.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNA certification or equivalent networking knowledge.
* Experience in enterprise network and security infrastructure integration.
* Basic knowledge of Windows and Linux environments.

title: Operations Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Operations Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Support the operations and/or manage delivery for production systems and services based on operational requirements and service agreement.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Network Infrastructures, Network Data, Juniper technology
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
Responsible for design, deployment, monitoring, and optimization of enterprise WAN, LAN, and WLAN environments using SD-WAN (Juniper SSR/SRX) and Juniper Mist AI platform, ensuring high availability, performance, and user experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* SD-WAN (WAN Domain)

Design, deploy, and manage SD-WAN solutions across branch and data center environments
  
  
Configure application-aware routing, traffic steering, and failover policies
  
  
Monitor WAN edge health, tunnels, and application performance using telemetry and analytics
  
  
Troubleshoot WAN issues (latency, packet loss, brownouts, ISP issues) and ensure service continuity
  
  
Support integration with SASE platforms (Prisma, Zscaler, Secure Edge)
  
  

* Juniper MIST (AIOps & Campus)

Monitor and manage network using Juniper Mist dashboards, SLEs, and Marvis AI insights
  
  
Perform AI-driven proactive troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA)
  
  
Analyze anomalies (Wi-Fi, LAN, WAN) and resolve issues before user impact
  
  
Optimize user experience using SLE metrics (latency, throughput, roaming, client health)
  
  
Implement configuration changes, RF optimization, and performance tuning
  
  

* Network Operations (VNOC/NOC)

Perform 24 7 monitoring, alert validation, and incident management
  
  
Execute proactive issue identification using trends and telemetry
  
  
Validate service restoration and maintain SLA/KPI compliance
  
  
Collaborate with L2/L3/OEM/ISP teams for escalations and permanent fixes
  
  
Maintain incident documentation, RCA, and continuous improvement initiatives
  
  

* Implementation & Projects

Lead or support network deployment, upgrades, and migration projects
  
  
Configure devices: Juniper SRX, SSR, EX switches, Mist APs
  
  
Perform integration testing, change execution, and rollout planning
  
  
Develop LLD, HLD, SOPs, and topology documentation
  
  

* Automation & Optimization

Leverage Mist APIs / automation tools for operational efficiency
  
  
Use AI insights to reduce MTTR / MTTI and incident volumes
  
  
Identify opportunities for automation and self-healing networks
  
  

* Stakeholder & Communication

Coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams
  
  
Provide technical updates, reports, and service health dashboards
  
  
Support audits, compliance, and governance processes
  
  
**Required Skills & Expertise**
Technical Skills
  
  
Strong knowledge of:
  
  

* Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF
* Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, VLAN, QoS
* SD-WAN architecture and deployment

Hands-on with:
  
  

* Juniper Mist AI (Wireless/Wired/WAN Assurance)
* Juniper SRX / SSR / EX / AP platforms

Experience in:
  
  

* Network troubleshooting & diagnostics tools
* Monitoring & analytics (telemetry-based operations)

Behavioral Skills
  
  
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  
  
Ability to work in high-pressure NOC/VNOC environments
  
  
Effective communication and stakeholder management
  
  
Fast learner with adaptability to new technologies
  
  
Experience & Qualification
  
  
4–10+ years in Network Engineering (WAN/LAN/WLAN)
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN (Juniper & Cisco)
  
  
**Certifications (Preferred)**
Juniper MIST (JNCIA-Mist / JNCIS-Mist)
  
  
Juniper Routing & Switching (JNCIA/JNCIS)
  
  
SD-WAN / CCNP / SASE certifications
  
  
Key Outcomes / KPIs
  
  
Improved user experience (SLE-driven operations)
  
  
Reduced MTTR / incident volume
  
  
High network availability & SLA compliance
  
  
Increased automation and proactive operations maturity

title: Office Administrator
description:
As an Office Administrator, you will be managing our office infrastructure, cash expenses, bill keeping, vendor management, assets setup and maintenance, supporting other teams to organize events, conduct meetings & conferences. You will be performing bookkeeping functions, managing housekeeping staff, keeping inventory records, and reloading office supplies as needed.

**Experience: 2 – 3 Years**

**Responsibilities:**

**Internal Office Administration:**

* Maintain office infrastructure and ensure its proper functioning by coordinating repairs, maintenance, and renovations as needed.
* Effectively keep a track of the maintenance activities, schedules, and service contracts to ensure timely and efficient upkeep.
* Manage office cash expenses, keeping a meticulous record of all expenses, bills, and invoices.
* Submit required bills and invoices to the auditing team in a timely manner for financial reconciliation and reporting.
* Manage relationships with vendors, including negotiating contracts, pricing, and terms.
* Source and evaluate potential new vendors to ensure cost-effectiveness and quality of services or supplies.
* Assist other teams in organizing events, meetings, conferences, and travel arrangements, including booking venues, accommodations, and transportation.
* Coordinate logistics, prepare materials, and provide on-site support for events and meetings.
* Manage office essentials and pantry items, ensuring that all items are well-stocked and replenished as needed.
* Monitor inventory levels, place orders, and maintain relationships with suppliers.
* Manage outsourced jobs ensuring they are completed on time, within budget, and to the desired quality standards.

**Office & IT Asset Management:**

* Ensure the management and maintenance of Office & IT assets and inventory for optimal business performance.
* Maintain accurate records of Office & IT assets, track their usage, and coordinate repairs or replacements as required.
* Develop an efficient system for tracking and allocating the assets to employees.
* Conduct periodic audits to ensure proper asset management and prevent loss or misuse.

**WP! & Sys Support Works:**

* Provide support to the system admin team for any requirements or tasks needed to maintain the office's technology infrastructure.
* Support and troubleshoot internal systems PCs, Laptops, LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN, Internet, Firewalls, and other hardware devices when required.
* Follow up with clients for prompt renewals of WP payments every month.
* Supporting WP team for prompt renewal of WP! accounts with respective vendors and update records.

**Required Skills:**

* Good experience in office infrastructure administration.
* Good M365 skills, including proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Good English communication and email writing skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal & customer relationship skills.
* Troubleshooting & problem-solving skills.
* Negotiation skills for vendor contracts and relationships.
* Familiarity with office equipment and technology, including IT assets.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
* Documentation skills.
* Risk management skills.

description:

* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.

* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.

 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world.
